headline: A federal law renames a Post Office building in Irvine, California, after a Tuskegee Airman, Lieutenant Colonel Robert J. Friend.
what_it_does: The law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1 League in Irvine, California, the Tuskegee Airman Lieutenant Colonel Robert J. Friend Memorial Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 23, 2022.
